question: Indira point is located in the southern part of which of the following islands?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Great Nicobar island**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Indira Point is the southernmost point of India, located on the Great Nicobar island in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
 
• It was named in honor of the former Prime Minister of India, Indira Gandhi.
 
• The point is located at latitude 6°45'10" N and longitude 93°49'36" E.
 
• Indira Point was formerly known as Pygmalion Point and Parsons Point.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Great Nicobar Island**

 
 
• Great Nicobar is the largest of the Nicobar Islands, with an area of about 1,045 square kilometers.
 
• It is located in the Indian Ocean, south of the Andaman Islands, and is part of the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
 
• The island is known for its rich biodiversity, including the Great Nicobar Biosphere Reserve, which is home to several endemic species.
 
• It is sparsely populated, with the majority of its inhabitants being the indigenous Nicobarese people.
 
 
 
• **Middle Andaman Island**
 
 
• Middle Andaman Island is part of the Andaman Islands, located in the Bay of Bengal.
 
• It is the second largest island in the Andaman group and is known for its lush green forests and diverse wildlife.
 
• The island is home to several indigenous tribes, including the Jarwa people.
 
• Middle Andaman Island is also known for its beautiful beaches and tourist attractions.
 
 
 
• **Car Nicobar Island**
 
 
• Car Nicobar is the northernmost island in the Nicobar group, located in the Bay of Bengal.
 
• It is the administrative capital of the Nicobar district and is known for its coconut plantations and scenic beauty.
 
• The island was significantly affected by the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami, which caused extensive damage and loss of life.
 
• The indigenous Nicobarese people are the main inhabitants of Car Nicobar.
 
 
 
• **Little Andaman Island**
 
 
• Little Andaman is the fourth largest island in the Andaman group, situated south of Port Blair.
 
• The island is known for its pristine beaches, waterfalls, and dense tropical forests.
 
• It is home to the Onge tribe, one of the indigenous tribes of the Andaman Islands.
 
• Little Andaman is a popular destination for eco-tourism and adventure activities.
